constraints.name: account_role_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((institution_id IS NOT NULL) <> (region_name IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: account_role_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((role_code)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['MEDICAL'::character varying, 'TRANSPORT'::character varying])::text[])) OR (institution_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: blood_allocation_current_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((current_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['RESERVED'::character varying, 'ASSIGNED'::character varying, 'IN_TRANSIT'::character varying, 'RECEIVED'::character varying, 'CANCELLED'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: blood_classification_recorded_group_code_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((recorded_group_code)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['O-'::character varying, 'O+'::character varying, 'A-'::character varying, 'A+'::character varying, 'B-'::character varying, 'B+'::character varying, 'AB-'::character varying, 'AB+'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: blood_request_current_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((current_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['OPEN'::character varying, 'IN_PROGRESS'::character varying, 'CLOSED'::character varying, 'CANCELLED'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: blood_unit_current_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((current_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['AVAILABLE'::character varying, 'QUARANTINED'::character varying, 'WITHDRAWN'::character varying, 'RESERVED'::character varying, 'IN_TRANSIT'::character varying, 'DELIVERED'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: donation_current_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((current_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['REGISTERED'::character varying, 'COLLECTED'::character varying, 'PROCESSED'::character varying, 'CANCELLED'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: donor_blood_group_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((blood_group)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['O-'::character varying, 'O+'::character varying, 'A-'::character varying, 'A+'::character varying, 'B-'::character varying, 'B+'::character varying, 'AB-'::character varying, 'AB+'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: institution_institution_type_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((institution_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['BLOOD_BANK'::character varying, 'HOSPITAL'::character varying, 'COORDINATION'::character varying, 'TRANSPLANT_CENTER'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: recipient_blood_group_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((blood_group)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['O-'::character varying, 'O+'::character varying, 'A-'::character varying, 'A+'::character varying, 'B-'::character varying, 'B+'::character varying, 'AB-'::character varying, 'AB+'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: shipment_current_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((current_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['SCHEDULED'::character varying, 'PREPARED'::character varying, 'COLLECTED'::character varying, 'IN_TRANSIT'::character varying, 'DELIVERED'::character varying, 'ACCEPTED'::character varying, 'CANCELLED'::character varying])::text[])))
